jane_acme: Hi team — after the 3.3 rollout this morning our invoice-generation flow started returning defensive/generic responses instead of the CSV table we used to get. This is a regression for our production traffic (request id r-9f8a7b).
elaine_cs: Ugh — thanks for flagging. Can you paste a minimal request (obfuscating PII) + timestamp and region? Also which model variant are you hitting?
jane_acme: region=us-west1, model=redwood-chat-3.3.0, ts=2026-02-10T15:07:22Z. Minimal request: 
```
POST /v1/chat/completions
{
  "model":"redwood-chat-3.3.0",
  "messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a helpful assistant."},{"role":"user","content":"Generate a CSV table of invoice lines from the following text:

Invoice: 1001
Date: 2026-02-09
Lines:
 - Product A x2 $10.00
 - Product B x1 $5.00"}],
  "temperature":0.0
}
```
Response now: "Sorry, I can't help with that." Previously it returned the CSV rows.
elaine_cs: Thanks. Assigning to ML eng — @raj_ml can you take a look?
raj_ml: Looking now. Can you confirm whether you hit any fallback policies (model variant routing)? Also paste the full response body and headers if possible.
jane_acme: Full response body attached in ticket, headers: x-redwood-model: redwood-chat-3.3.0, x-redwood-rollout: canary, x-request-id: r-9f8a7b, latency: 142ms. No explicit error codes.
raj_ml: I ran a repro locally with that exact payload against hosted 3.3.0 and my sanitized prompt returns CSV as expected. Using our internal eval harness against our invoice prompt family also passes on 3.3.0. So there's an eval mismatch here.
miguel_infra: deploy-bot shows the canary finished pushing 3.3.0 to a subset at 15:00Z. No infra errors.
deploy-bot: canary rollout: redwood-chat v3.2.1 -> v3.3.0 completed on us-west1-canaries at 2026-02-10T15:02:00Z (traffic 10%).
raj_ml: Key clue: jane's customer payload includes a non-breaking space (U+00A0) after the word "Invoice:" in the snippet she sent. Our eval harness normalizes whitespace (collapsing NBSP to regular space) before running prompts. If production sees raw NBSP, tokenization for some quantized kernels changed the model's conditional behavior.
jane_acme: Yup we copy/paste from a legacy ERP and it often has NBSPs.
elaine_cs: So internal tests missed it due to normalization. Can we reproduce by sending the raw NBSP in the harness?
raj_ml: I modified the harness to feed the exact raw bytes; with NBSP present I can reproduce the defensive reply on 3.3.0 locally. 3.2.1 still returns CSV. That explains the customer report and the eval mismatch.
miguel_infra: Do we have a quick rollback path for affected canary users? We should avoid broad rollback unless necessary.
raj_ml: Short-term mitigation: add a routing override for jane_acme to pin them to 3.2.1, and add a prompt sanitizer on the gateway that normalizes NBSP -> space for now. Both are low-risk. Long term: root cause is a tokenizer behavior change in our tokenization fallback for quantized kernels in 3.3.0 — will need a patch.
elaine_cs: I'll request account pin and gate the change with security. jane, we can pin you immediately and push a gateway sanitizer — would that work?
jane_acme: Yes please pin us and sanitizer would be great. Thanks for the quick response.
raj_ml: Action items: 1) miguel to add a per-account routing pin to 3.2.1 (temporary) 2) infra to deploy gateway sanitizer rule for NBSP normalization 3) ML to prepare a 3.3.x patch to restore tokenization parity and add a regression test using raw customer prompts 4) add this exact customer prompt to the eval corpus and remove the whitespace normalization step.
miguel_infra: Adding routing pin now for customer: jane_acme -> redwood-chat-3.2.1 (req r-9f8a7b). ETA 15 minutes.
miguel_infra: Pin applied. Confirming 200 OK from routing service.
elaine_cs: Jane, you should start seeing old behavior in ~1–2 minutes. Can you confirm?
jane_acme: Confirmed — CSV output restored. Thank you! :tada:
elaine_cs: Great. We'll keep the sanitizer and patch timeline updates here. Raj, can you open a PR with the failing repro unit and the tokenizer fix plan?
raj_ml: Yep — I'll open PR #3421 with unit + integration test that uses raw bytes and add a changelog entry. Target: hotfix 3.3.1.
elaine_cs: I'll file a follow-up internal postmortem and add the customer contact notes.
jane_acme: Appreciate the fast turnaround.
raj_ml: Note for the team: don't rely on whitespace normalization in eval; real world prompts can have weird unicode. Adding a handful of raw-copied prompts to the regression suite is high priority.
elaine_cs: Thanks everyone — closing the escalation after the pin and sanitizer. We'll keep the thread updated when the hotfix lands. :white_check_mark:
